hidden_homeroom_d2_low.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_low.text: *I meet my homeroom teacher at the staff-room door. She turns her file folder inward.* I'm busy today, so it's hard to talk separately. See you in class.

hidden_homeroom_d2_neg.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_neg.text: *She draws the file folder in against her chest and looks away.* Nothing to discuss today. Get back to the classroom.

morning2_start.name: {name}
morning2_start.text: *My second morning after transferring. The creases in my uniform sleeves have faded since yesterday. Recalling the timetable I wrote down yesterday, I pause outside our classroom's front door.*

morning2_greet_seo_1_roof.name: Seoyeon
morning2_greet_seo_1_roof.text: The promise you made with me on the roof yesterday. You didn't forget, and you kept it open, right?

morning2_greet_seo_1_gate.name: Seoyeon
morning2_greet_seo_1_gate.text: I'm here for the morning headcount. Sit down.

morning2_greet_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
morning2_greet_seo_2.text: You're early today. Finding your way to the classroom isn't confusing anymore, right? *At Seoyeon's voice from the doorway, Dain's chair shifts beside me and Yuna turns a page by the window.*

morning2_greet_seo_others_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_seo_others_2.text: *Seoyeon taps the back of her clipboard with a long finger and leaves a smile in her eyes that only I can see.*

morning2_greet_dain_2.name: Dain
morning2_greet_dain_2.text: Hey, you still not awake? I don't want to greet someone's back first thing in the morning! *She comes up from behind and taps my shoulder.*

morning2_greet_dain_others.name: {name}
morning2_greet_dain_others.text: Dain, I'll be wiped out before homeroom starts. Just your voice, and it feels like I've run ten laps around the field. *Seoyeon passes by the hall window, turning a page on her clipboard.*

morning2_greet_dain_others_seo.name: Seoyeon
morning2_greet_dain_others_seo.text: Full of energy, this early in the morning.

morning2_greet_dain_others_yuna.name: {name}
morning2_greet_dain_others_yuna.text: *In the seat behind me, the tip of Yuna's fountain pen pauses, leaving a tiny violet ink dot on the corner of her open notebook.*

morning2_greet_yuna_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_yuna_2.text: *I unfold the neatly creased note in my hand; written in pale violet ink is a single line: 'To the library annex at lunch.'*

morning2_greet_yuna_others.name: Seoyeon
morning2_greet_yuna_others.text: A secret letter, this early in the morning?

morning2_greet_yuna_others_seo.name: Seoyeon
morning2_greet_yuna_others_seo.text: That note in your hand. Something I, the student council president, am not allowed to see? *Seoyeon's gaze settles on the corner of the paper in my hand.*

morning2_greet_yuna_others_dain.name: Dain
morning2_greet_yuna_others_dain.text: Oh, what's that! Show me too, quick!

morning2_greet_yuna_others_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_yuna_others_2.text: *I quickly fold the note in half and hide it in my hand. Inside my sweaty palm, the paper's crease presses tight.*

morning2_yuna_seen.name: Yuna
morning2_yuna_seen.text: ...Strange. You really seem like someone I've seen somewhere before.

morning2_note_1.name: {name}
morning2_note_1.text: *I hang my bag and go to sit, and a neatly folded note is sitting in the middle of the desk.*

morning2_note_2.name: {name}
morning2_note_2.text: *'Come to the library annex at lunch. — Yuna'*

morning2_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
morning2_seo_1.text: *Stepping back into the hallway, Seoyeon pokes her head slightly back in through the open front door.* Oh, right—did you sleep well last night without tossing and turning?

morning2_seo_4.name: {name}
morning2_seo_4.text: For a busy student council president, you sure drop by someone else's classroom doorway a lot in the morning.

morning2_seo_5.name: Seoyeon
morning2_seo_5.text: I stopped for a second on my way to drop papers at the staff room. Just wanted to see if your face was still in one piece.

morning2_minsu_1.name: Seoyeon
morning2_minsu_1.text: I've seen you now, so I'll get going. It wouldn't look good if I came to see you and ended up late. *As Seoyeon turns, the end of her clipboard taps the doorframe.*

morning2_minsu_1b.name: {name}
morning2_minsu_1b.text: *I'm looking down the hall where Seoyeon's long hair disappeared when Minsu, in the seat in front, whips around like he can't believe it.*

morning2_minsu_3.name: Minsu
morning2_minsu_3.text: Hey, you've only been here two days, and the student council president already comes to the door to say hello? I've been here a whole year and can barely even catch her eye in the hall.

morning2_dain_claim_1.name: {name}
morning2_dain_claim_1.text: Isn't that just you not being popular?

morning2_dain_claim_2.name: Minsu
morning2_dain_claim_2.text: Don't hit me where it hurts. It's true, but that's not the point right now!

morning2_dain_claim_3.name: {name}
morning2_dain_claim_3.text: *Past the hall window, Seoyeon flashes by with the clipboard hugged to her chest, fingers brushing her ear as she walks.*

morning2_dain_claim_4.name: Dain
morning2_dain_claim_4.text: Oh. Even that aloof student council president seems pretty interested in our transfer student. You're more popular than I thought!

morning2_dain_claim_5.name: {name}
morning2_dain_claim_5.text: Did you just say “our” transfer student?

morning2_dain_claim_6.name: Dain
morning2_dain_claim_6.text: Obviously. Same class, and I'm the partner in the seat right next to you! I can claim at least that much ownership.

morning2_break_transition.name: {name}
morning2_break_transition.text: *Period 1 ends, and I step out to the hall window to cool off the noisy heat of the classroom.*

morning2_break_transition_b.name: {name}
morning2_break_transition_b.text: *At the classroom door, I meet the eyes of the homeroom teacher passing by, the attendance book hugged to her chest.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_1.text: Good timing, {name}. Come with me to the staff room for a minute.

hidden_homeroom_d2_1_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_1_b.text: Did some kind of problem come up?

hidden_homeroom_d2_1_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_1_c.text: No need to be scared. There's still transfer paperwork left to check. It's purely administrative.

hidden_homeroom_d2_2.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_2.text: *Between the attendance book in the homeroom teacher's arms, the corner of the transfer papers with my name on them sticks out a little.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_2_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_2_b.text: *As I approach the homeroom teacher's desk, a stack of manuscript paper is visible through the half-open drawer.* Teacher, is it all right if I sit in this chair?

hidden_homeroom_d2_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_3.text: Yeah, have a seat. Looking at your records from your old school, your Korean grades stood out—does the subject suit you well?

hidden_homeroom_d2_3_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_3_b.text: Reading the passages in class just feels less boring than the rest.

hidden_homeroom_d2_3_c.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_3_c.text: You have quite a lot of literature books on your desk here too. *Over the stack of manuscript paper in the open drawer, she quietly lays the attendance book.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_3_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_3_d.text: Call it an occupational hazard. Have you ever tried writing something yourself?

hidden_homeroom_d2_3_e.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_3_e.text: *Her gaze brushes past the half-open drawer before returning straight to me.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_3_f.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_3_f.text: I'm not sure yet if writing it myself is really my thing.

hidden_homeroom_d2_3_g.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_3_g.text: Oh, the drawer rail caught again. Anyway, outside of textbooks, do you read much on your own? *Nudging the stuck drawer shut with her knee, she meets my eyes.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1.text: *Hand off the drawer, the homeroom teacher waits for my answer across the steam rising from her coffee mug.*
choices: What about you? What do you read?
You only read difficult books, right?

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1_a.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1_a.text: I read mystery novels a lot. Less about who the culprit is, more about following someone's heart all the way, to why they made that choice.

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1_b.text: *With her fingertips, she rolls the handle of the coffee cup.* Really? Being able to quietly look into someone else's story is a good hobby.

hidden_homeroom_d2_5.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_5.text: Well, I didn't ask because it meant anything much. I was just curious.

hidden_homeroom_d2_6.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_6.text: My desk's a bit cluttered, isn't it? Start of the semester means a pile of paperwork to sort. *She taps a stack of handouts neat at the corner of her desk.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_7.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_7.text: So how's day two treating you? Does the class feel a bit more comfortable than yesterday?

hidden_homeroom_d2_7_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_7_b.text: Yes. It's much more comfortable than yesterday. The kids in class talk to me first, too.

hidden_homeroom_d2_8.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_8.text: Dain next to you is very noisy, right? But a kid who stirs up trouble and a kid with overflowing energy are completely different.

hidden_homeroom_d2_8_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_8_b.text: Hearing you put it that way, Teacher, Dain must be pretty well-known in the staff room too.

hidden_homeroom_d2_8_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_8_c.text: It's not so much that she's famous. As her homeroom teacher, she just keeps being on my mind. *She holds a sip of warm coffee and lowers her eyes.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_8_d.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_8_d.text: *In the open attendance book, beside the two characters “Dain,” the pen tip in the homeroom teacher's hand pauses.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_8_e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_8_e.text: *She sets the coffee cup down without a sound.* Anyway, your transfer paperwork is all processed now. Nothing out of order.

hidden_homeroom_d2_9.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_9.text: That's a relief. I got a little nervous thinking I might've missed a form.

hidden_homeroom_d2_10.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_10.text: This much is just what a homeroom teacher ought to do. Don't get awkward about it, like you owe me.

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2.text: *The homeroom teacher's fingertips brush the corner of the cork coaster twice, in the same spot.*
choices: For 'just work,' you look pretty happy about it.
Thanks for looking out for me.
Is checking on me like this part of your job, too?

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_trap.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_trap.text: *The finger turning the coaster stops dead.* If you read a teacher's consideration that way, that's a problem.

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_a.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_a.text: If the new student in my class is settling in well, of course that feels good.

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_b.text: Well, hearing you put it like that makes sorting all that paperwork feel worth it.

hidden_homeroom_d2_11.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_11.text: Other kids in class come by too, when something's weighing on them. You can drop in anytime.

hidden_homeroom_d2_11_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_11_b.text: You don't need to feel sorry for coming to the staff room. It's okay if you don't say things that are still hard to bring up. *Looking down into the coffee, she adds it in a low voice.*

morning2_seo_dust_1.name: Seoyeon
morning2_seo_dust_1.text: What were you even doing during period 1? *In the hall, Seoyeon stops and looks at my shoulder.*

morning2_seo_dust_2.name: Seoyeon
morning2_seo_dust_2.text: Don't move. Stay still for a second.

morning2_seo_dust_3.name: Seoyeon
morning2_seo_dust_3.text: *Seoyeon steps closer, and her fingertips touch my uniform at the shoulder. With a gentle touch, she lightly brushes the dust off twice.*

morning2_seo_dust_4.name: Seoyeon
morning2_seo_dust_4.text: There was something like chalk dust on your shoulder.

morning2_seo_dust_5.name: {name}
morning2_seo_dust_5.text: Your hand came in out of nowhere without a word—you startled me. *Feeling weirdly self-conscious, I tug my uniform blazer straight.*

morning2_seo_dust_6.name: Seoyeon
morning2_seo_dust_6.text: Why jump like that? I only brushed some dust off.

morning2_dain_react_1.name: {name}
morning2_dain_react_1.text: *Even though the dust is clearly gone, the spot on my shoulder where Seoyeon's fingertips brushed still tingles, leaving me rubbing the back of my neck.*

morning2_dain_react_3.name: Dain
morning2_dain_react_3.text: Hey, what was that just now? The student council president touched your shoulder, right?

morning2_dain_react_4.name: {name}
morning2_dain_react_4.text: She didn't touch it. She brushed the dust off my shoulder.

morning2_dain_react_5.name: Dain
morning2_dain_react_5.text: Suspicious. Was there actually dust stuck there?

morning2_dain_react_6.name: {name}
morning2_dain_react_6.text: She really just brushed off some dust, I swear. Why are you squinting at me like that? *I quietly slip the hand from my shoulder into my pocket.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_freetalk.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_freetalk.text: *She turns her chair toward me.* Anything else you wanted to ask?
hidden_homeroom_d2_freetalk.context: It is the morning of Day 2, just after a counseling meeting in the faculty office. The transfer student happened to glimpse a long manuscript in the homeroom teacher's drawer but does not yet know its contents or history. They are a teacher and student beginning to build trust. Do not invent the manuscript's secret or cross the teacher-student boundary.
hidden_homeroom_d2_freetalk.personality: The homeroom teacher is calm, responsible, and listens before she advises. Her embarrassment about the personal manuscript appears in a brief hesitation, but she does not place emotional responsibility on the student and keeps a warm, appropriate boundary.

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1_trap.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1_trap.text: Being a language teacher doesn't mean the books I read on my breaks have to be difficult and dry.

morning2_greet_none_1.name: {name}
morning2_greet_none_1.text: *I open the classroom door and step in, and no one comes over. Only the sound of my bag set down at my seat rings out, heavy.*

morning2_greet_none_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_none_2.text: *Passing the hallway window, Seoyeon only flips through her clipboard while Dain turns toward her friends. By the window, Yuna doesn't lift her eyes from her open book.*

morning2_greet_none_neg_1.name: {name}
morning2_greet_none_neg_1.text: *I open the classroom's front door, and the looks that had flicked over scatter, cold, as if they'd agreed. The sound of my bag set down echoes far too loud.*

morning2_greet_none_neg_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_none_neg_2.text: *In the end, not one of the three gives this way so much as a glance.*

morning2_greet_dain_1_fun.name: Dain
morning2_greet_dain_1_fun.text: Hey, yesterday was really fun, right! Let's do something exciting together today too!

morning2_greet_dain_1_plain.name: Dain
morning2_greet_dain_1_plain.text: Oh, good morning! Pack today full of energy too!

morning2_greet_yuna_1_thanks.name: Yuna
morning2_greet_yuna_1_thanks.text: *As I pick up the note resting on the corner of my desk, my eyes brush past Yuna's by the window.* ...Thanks for staying beside me yesterday.
